LanguageData.RMPits_DigDeeperDesc: Queue a deepening pass on this pit. Needed for Deep and Chasm tiers.
LanguageData.RMPits_ArmCoverDesc: Cover this pit so it triggers once {0} kg of standing mass crosses it.
LanguageData.RMPits_UncoverDesc: Remove the cover. The pit becomes a plain open hole again.
LanguageData.RMPits_ReleaseDesc: Pull the pit's occupant out. They are placed on the ground nearby.
LanguageData.RMPits_ToggleGateDesc: Open exposes the captive to the sun; closed is the mercy.
LanguageData.RMPits_AssignPrisonerDesc: Mark a colony prisoner for this cell.
LanguageData.RMPits_PlaceInPitCellDesc: Move the assigned prisoner into the cell now (stand-in for a real carry job - see item file).
LanguageData.RMPits_FeedCaptiveDesc: Restore the held captive's food need (stand-in for a real feed-through-the-gate job - see item file).
